boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on or beside campus-adjacent corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Museum of Fine Arts, Boston
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk Huntington Avenue to the museum and use its visit page to plan a gallery visit, including the current ticket and entrance details.
cards.short_summary: An art museum on the Avenue of the Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Museum of Fine Arts, Boston lists its address as 465 Huntington Avenue and identifies the Huntington Avenue Entrance as its main entrance.
cards.source_title: Getting Here | Museum of Fine Arts Boston
cards.access_notes: The museum directs visitors to obtain tickets before arriving at its main entrance.

cards.title: Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
cards.subtitle: Evans Way off Huntington Avenue
cards.notes: Take Evans Way from Huntington Avenue to the Gardner Museum, then reserve a timed ticket before visiting its collection and courtyard.
cards.short_summary: A historic art museum immediately off the Huntington corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum is at 25 Evans Way, and its visitor guidance recommends advanced ticketing.
cards.source_title: Prepare for Your Visit | Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum
cards.access_notes: Advanced ticketing is recommended; the museum publishes current hours and ticket details.

cards.title: Symphony Hall
cards.subtitle: Massachusetts Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow Massachusetts Avenue to Symphony Hall and check the orchestra’s calendar before choosing a current concert or visitor program.
cards.short_summary: A concert hall anchoring the Symphony area.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Symphony Orchestra identifies Symphony Hall as its performance venue at 301 Massachusetts Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Performance access, timing, and ticket requirements vary by the published event.

cards.title: The Christian Science Plaza
cards.subtitle: Massachusetts Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the Plaza’s outdoor reflecting pool and landscaped grounds while walking Massachusetts Avenue; check visitor information for indoor attractions.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped public plaza beside the Symphony corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Christian Science Plaza describes its 670-foot reflecting pool and landscaped outdoor grounds.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor grounds are publicly accessible; indoor destinations have separate visitor policies.

cards.title: Boston Public Library, Central Library
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk Boylston Street toward Copley Square for the Central Library, then use BPL’s site to confirm current programs and building access.
cards.short_summary: Boston’s main public-library campus on Boylston Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Boston Public Library lists its Central Library address as 700 Boylston Street, Boston.
cards.access_notes: Check BPL’s current location and program information before visiting a specific room or event.

cards.title: The Shops at Prudential Center
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue on Boylston Street to the Prudential Center’s indoor concourse and consult the official directory for current stores and services.
cards.short_summary: An indoor shopping complex just off Boylston Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Prudential Center visitor page lists The Shops at Prudential Center at 800 Boylston Street.
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses establish their own hours, access conditions, and purchase requirements.

cards.title: Fenway Park
cards.subtitle: Jersey Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk Jersey Street to view the ballpark exterior, or use the Red Sox’s official page to schedule a tour or ticketed event.
cards.short_summary: A historic ballpark on the Jersey Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boston Red Sox identify Fenway Park at 4 Jersey Street and offer official ballpark tours.
cards.source_title: Fenway Park Tours | Boston Red Sox
cards.access_notes: Tours and games are scheduled separately and require the applicable ticket.

cards.title: Fenway Community Center
cards.subtitle: Boylston Street corridor
cards.notes: Head west on Boylston Street to the community center and review its calendar for current neighborhood programs before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A community-program venue near the Fenway edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Fenway Community Center lists its address as 1282 Boylston Street and presents community programs and events.
cards.access_notes: Program availability, registration, and any fees vary by event.

cards.title: New England Conservatory
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use Huntington Avenue to reach the conservatory and select a public performance from its official events calendar before you go.
cards.short_summary: A conservatory with public performance listings near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: New England Conservatory’s events site publishes performances and lists its Boston campus at 290 Huntington Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Admission, timing, and availability are specific to each listed performance.

cards.entity_name: Massachusetts College of Art and Design
cards.title: Massachusetts College of Art and Design
cards.subtitle: Huntington Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue southwest along Huntington Avenue to MassArt and check its visitor or gallery listings for public-facing exhibitions and events.
cards.short_summary: An art-college destination along Huntington Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Massachusetts College of Art and Design lists its address as 621 Huntington Avenue, Boston.
cards.access_notes: Campus buildings, galleries, and programs may have separate current visitor requirements.
